key_positions: Promote innovation-led climate solutions through market mechanisms
Invest heavily in clean energy R&D including nuclear, solar, and wind
Rejoin and lead international climate agreements such as the Paris Accord
Support carbon capture and sequestration technologies
Transition to electric vehicles with federal incentives
Protect American jobs during the energy transition
red_lines: No unilateral carbon tariffs that harm US exports without reciprocity
Reject any agreement that gives economic competitors an unfair advantage
Oppose mandates that would eliminate fossil fuels before alternatives are ready
Resist transfer of sovereign energy policy decisions to international bodies
stance_summary: The USA supports a technology-first, market-driven approach to climate change, emphasizing innovation, economic competitiveness, and voluntary international cooperation rather than binding mandates.
